Package arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters

Class ProvideDocumentParam

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Parameter
arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters.ProvideDocumentParam
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class ProvideDocumentParam
extends Parameter
This class is used to pass details to post documents in ELGA. The class attributes provides all necessary information to be able to post a document in ELGA.
Author:
ET-Innovations

    • getMetadata

      public arztis.econnector.ihe.documents.ELGADocumentMetadata getMetadata()
      Metadata for the CDA document, which are not included in the document. The following metadata are needed to post a document in ELGA, but are not necessarily available in the CDA document:
      • patient's social security number
      • healthcare facility code of the uploading organization
      • practice setting code of the uploading physician or organization
      Actual values for the codes are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at
      Returns:

    • getOidOrganization

      public java.lang.String getOidOrganization()
      OID of the organization, which wants to post the document. It must be the same OID like in the HCP Assertion. To extract this OID from the HCP assertion the method getOrganizationIdByUserId() in ElgaConnectionCaller is implemented.
      Returns:
      OID of the organization

    • getCdaDoc

      public org.ehealth_connector.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040ClinicalDocument getCdaDoc()
      Instance of CDA document (POCDMT000040ClinicalDocument). This is used to extract all necessary metadata of the CDA document. This could be generated by the usage of
      • an appropriate JSON and for example the class ArztisUpdateImmunizationState. This version is implemented in the ElgaConnectionCaller in the method generateUpdateImmunizationEntry
      • the existing CDA as XML and the class UpdateImmunizationState. This version is implemented in the ElgaConnectionCaller in the method getDetailsOfUpdateImmunization
      Returns:
      instance of CDA document

    • setCdaDoc

      public void setCdaDoc​(org.ehealth_connector.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040ClinicalDocument cdaDoc)

    • setKindOfRequest

      public void setKindOfRequest​(int kindOfRequest)
      sets the kind of request, which posted the document. Possible values are
      • 0 - eBefunde
      • 1 - virtuelle Organisationen
      • 2 - eImpfpass
      • 3 - eMedikation
      This parameter is used to get the appropriate endpoint for each ELGA application.

    • isValidate

      public boolean isValidate()
      Specifies whether the document should be validated before it is posted to ELGA. The validation includes a schema and schematron validation. It needs some time to be executed, therefore the request will be slower, if this parameter is true.
      Returns:
      true if the document should be validated, otherwise false
